dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal region contains several irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures defined by high-contrast, jagged light-gray perimeters. These rings feature a sharp gradient transition from a bright exterior edge to a darker, lower-intensity interior that matches the primary coat color.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of low-intensity dark clusters surrounded by high-intensity light-gray borders. True solid high-intensity blobs lacking internal gradients are sparse, appearing only as small, isolated pixel aggregates between the larger annular motifs.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an elongated scalene triangle. The most anterior pair of large rings are spaced closer together than the distance from the central ring to the most posterior prominent ring on the upper flank.
